    vertical_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=20, y=10, width=0.5, height=5, angle=0, density=1.0)

    # Beam 3: y=12 (middle upper)
    horizontal_beam_3 = sandbox.add_beam(x=20, y=12, width=5, height=1, angle=0, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(vertical_beam, horizontal_beam_3, (20, 10), type='rigid')
    
    # Beam 4: y=14 (upper middle)
    horizontal_beam_4 = sandbox.add_beam(x=20, y=14, width=5, height=1, angle=0, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(vertical_beam, horizontal_beam_4, (20, 10), type='rigid')
